authorization.covers: one sentence authorizes all three region-repair rescue arms together

ceiling_derivation.finding: every prior attempt on these cells charged exactly 1 call and terminated at status=candidate_exhaustion in round 0
ceiling_derivation.rule: 250 authorized per cell minus measured lifetime charged calls

payload.claim_boundary: SEPARATE, VERSIONED REGION-REPAIR RESCUE. Run under its own contract identity, app and volume, at a per-cell ceiling below the arm's 250, with a proposal law that DIFFERS from the v1 arm it would be compared against. It must never be spliced into the unchanged-v1 250-call panel table without being named as a rescue. The mechanism is scoped to the LARGE-EXCISION pool: it neither reaches nor suppresses the micro (plus or minus one atom) pool, so for a cell whose only in-ball rescue is a one-atom edit this changes nothing and takes nothing away

exclusions_carried_forward.5ht1b_2: excluded on mechanism, not on failure: its witnesses need a different region SHAPE (two-boundary interior excision plus one reattachment bond) which the law does not draw, and the production executor's charge policy refuses 9 of 16 pendant regions on that source with zero refusals on every neutral cell; bond_insert is outside the frozen Active8 codec surface so reattachment would have to be cycle_close
exclusions_carried_forward.chemistry_screen: kept narrow; no filter added while support survives
exclusions_carried_forward.protonation: no protonation or charge-state edit enters this rescue; the protonation route is a separate configuration and mixing it would make the mechanism unattributable

allowed_adapter_changes: cell list restricted to the exhausted cells
per-cell budget reduced by the measured prior charged calls
separate rescue app, volume and output namespace
frozen_from.forbidden_changes: delta, proposal widths, the other proposal lanes, FiberControl features or fitting, expert-floor schedule, parent selection, exploration, endpoint gates, docking box, docking seed, evaluator, controller seeds, retries or replacements

isolation.guarantee: app, volume and output namespace all differ from the parent arm and from the other rescue arms

mechanism.name: bridge-separated region-draw law (free gate margin)
mechanism.support_relation: the repaired support is a strict superset of v1's; it RE-RANKS rather than filters

payload.primary_baselines: read-only measured roots and reported IVG delta=0.6 values; no comparator value enters runtime
payload.primary_model_output: FiberControl selection over complete shallow, anchored, and leave-target-out route programs

region_law_declaration.ASSERTION: THIS FIELD IS LOAD-BEARING. If it is absent the rescue runs law=None, which is v1 byte-identical, and the whole budget is spent reproducing the same candidate exhaustion. Its presence under proposal.shallow is the difference between the rescue and a repeat of the failure it exists to fix
region_law_declaration.absent_means: law=None, v1 byte-identical for every non-opted-in caller
region_law_declaration.consumption_check: assert_region_law_is_consumed runs the production proposal path until the draw site consults a probe, so a signed field that nothing reads fails closed
region_law_declaration.must_not_appear_elsewhere: assert_no_unconsumable_region_law_request raises on every proposal worker if region_law is declared at the top level or under any lane other than shallow, because only shallow reaches a synthesizer that threads it
region_law_declaration.verified_field_surface: region_law_contract.CONTRACT_FIELD == 'region_law' and CONTRACT_LANE == 'shallow', read from the merged source, not from a message

runtime_pin_changes.added_rationale: bridge_region_law.py and region_law_contract.py are in no existing pin block, so without these entries the module implementing the repair would be unpinned and free to drift
runtime_pin_changes.app_pin_is_the_safety_guard: _validate_task re-hashes every runtime_inputs_sha256 entry including the app path, so a contract pinning the WIRED app cannot run against an unwired one
runtime_pin_changes.verified_against: recomputed from the merged tree at 2397522f, not copied from a message

payload.scientific_problem: test transfer of a route-trained structural-action prior to braf with every braf route excluded from fitting

scope_of_the_mechanism.micro_pool_unchanged: size-1 regions are identical under both arms (8 / 5 / 9 on braf_0 / fa7_0 / fa7_2) because the cap only removed LARGE regions and the 0.05 support floor keeps every drawable region positive

per_cell_claim_basis.braf_0: TWO one-module eligible children under the repair: a one-module witness
per_cell_claim_basis.braf_1: no one-module child count was separately reported; this cell rests on the multi-draw closure, not on a demonstrated one-module witness

scope_of_the_mechanism.pool: large-excision regions; braf_0, braf_1 and fa7_2 witnesses live there

behavioural draws: braf_0 OFF 0 / ON 4 at 24 draws; 6 / 10 / 12 at 40 draws

one_contract_cannot_span_two_receptors.evidence: docking_box is a contract-level field and the receptor is an image-build env var, so the five-cell scope is split across three arms: braf_d06 496, fa7_d06 496, fa7_d04 249

supersedes_plan_preconditions.plan_is_immutable: the plan is pinned by hash and is NOT edited; it stays the record of the scope and ceilings as first fixed, and this block carries what has since changed

repair_not_in_the_campaign_tree.evidence: bridge_region_law.py and region_law_contract.py exist at wiring commit 2397522f and every pinned hash was recomputed from that tree

repair_not_reachable_from_any_contract.evidence: region_law_contract exposes CONTRACT_FIELD='region_law' on CONTRACT_LANE='shallow'; region_law_request returns 'free_gate_margin_v1' from this contract and build_region_law constructs a BridgeRegionLaw for every declared cell, verified by running the real functions against this payload in a checkout of the merged tree

trigger_rule.rule: a rescue triggers on MEASURED candidate exhaustion only, never on target identity and never on losing to the IVG comparator
